component.name: Fetchly
component.summary: Faster downloads with many connections at once

description.p: Fetchly is a download manager. It splits each file into parts and downloads them over several connections at once, which is faster on servers that limit each connection, and it resumes interrupted downloads instead of starting over.
With the Fetchly browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, downloads and videos go straight to Fetchly.
